content.text: •HTN associated w/ MI, HF, stroke, & CKD
: sympathetic/RAAS overactivation, defect in natriuresis, variations in cardiovascular/renal development, ↑ intracellular Na/Ca levels
resistant to max doses of 3 drugs
: aortic coarctation, Cushing’s, pheochromocytoma, thyroid disorders, hypercalcemia/hyperparathyroidism, acromegaly
: +/- hemorrhage, papilledema, cotton wool spots, arteriolar narrowing, AV nicking (hypertensive retinopathy)
BP ≥130/80 when averaged from 2+ readings obtained on 2+ occasions
: CBC, CMP (GFR, creatinine, Na/K/Ca), fasting blood glucose, lipid profile, uric acid, UA, TSH
ACEI/ARB or CCB or thiazide-like diuretic
F/u q4wks until BP controlled, then q3-6mo
*if BP uncontrolled, escalate doses on current drugs to at least half max dose before adding additional agent
– add agent from among 3 preferred classes
